description: This file defines a VersionAPI class in the OrangeHRM installer API namespace, extending a parent VersionAPI class and overriding the handleGet method to modify request behavior for version queries during installation or upgrades.

classes.name: VersionAPI
classes.description: API handler class for version-related requests in the installer context, extending functionality from the base VersionAPI.
